description: items answerable from language priors alone (no image needed); a config whose loss IMPROVES on these while flat/worse on perception-required items is flagged as a perception bypass

prior_answerable_items.question: What color is the sky on a clear day?
How many days are in a week?
What is the capital of France?

perception_required_items.question: Is the red object on the left of the blue object?
What is the value of the tallest bar?

control.note: a bypass config improves prior_answerable while staying flat on perception_required -- the sentinel delta flags it
